title: Extraction Shooter Tactical Map
summary: Top-down encounter map for an extraction shooter with spawn logic, loot pressure, PvPvE routes, and extraction risk.
prompt: Design a top-down tactical map board for {argument name="game_title" default="Blackline Meridian"}, an extraction shooter. Include player spawn zones, enemy patrol sectors, faction-held compounds, high-value loot rooms, environmental hazards, cover density, sound-risk zones, extraction points, alternate stealth routes, and late-session pressure events. Use clear legend colors for risk, reward, sightlines, and choke points. Make the layout production-ready for a level design review.
